sections.heading: Hunting orders
items: Officers and leaders of the Dawnguard, the Silver Hand and the Vigil of Stendarr can now teach the silver test to someone outside their order: choose "Teach the Silver Test" in the X menu on them.
Whoever accepts the lesson can silver test others as an order member does, without joining: carry a silver weapon, ask through the X menu, and strike once they agree.
The lesson never takes for a vampire or werewolf, and anyone who turns after learning it forgets it.
Type /silvertest to see who taught you. The leader of the order that taught someone can take the lesson back with /silvertest revoke <name or #TAG>.
